John Leake is a true-crime author who has written on medical and scientific scandals. He joins Tucker Carlson to discuss what he calls the demonic rituals used to replicate God. He also treats science itself as mankind's new religion. The conversation treats modern biotechnology as a spiritual project, not just a technical one.

Leake and Carlson argue that the drive to remake life, extend it indefinitely, and create intelligence mirrors older religious ambitions with the faith stripped out. That framing lets them connect laboratory news to theology in a single argument. The episode will divide listeners: some will hear a warning, others a category error. Either way, it records a distinctly Carlson-era claim, that the real fight over science is a fight about God.
